title: Document skeleton (document-skeleton.json)
description: The seed ProseMirror document a new document of a format starts from — answers 'what standard structure already exists before the user types anything', as opposed to config.json which answers 'how does this render'. See FORMAT_CONFIG_GUIDE.md. `doc` is validated separately against prosemirror-base.schema.json at load time; this schema only checks the wrapper shape.

doc.description: A ProseMirror doc. Nodes carry attrs.locked:true (standard, fixed structure, read-only to the end user) or attrs.fillIn:true (intentionally empty, no placeholder text). Validated in full against prosemirror-base.schema.json separately.
